strings.d1.s0.name: Nyhavn
strings.d1.s0.tips: Colourful 17th-century harbour; Andersen lived at number 20. Empty in the morning, and canal tours leave from here.
strings.d1.s1.name: Canal Tour Copenhagen
strings.d1.s1.tips: One-hour canal tour (Stromma/Netto is cheaper); see the Little Mermaid from the water, plus the Opera House and Christianshavn.
strings.d1.s2.name: Amalienborg Palace
strings.d1.s2.tips: The royal residence; changing of the guard at 12:00, with the dome of the Marble Church beyond.
strings.d1.s3.name: Torvehallerne
strings.d1.s3.tips: Glass market hall at Nørreport; Hallernes smørrebrød (open sandwiches), Grød porridge, Coffee Collective.
strings.d1.s4.name: Rundetårn
strings.d1.s4.tips: Round Tower from 1642; a spiral ramp leads up to views over the city.
strings.d1.b0.name: Schønnemann
strings.d1.b0.tips: A smørrebrød institution since 1877; book ahead, and try the herring with schnapps.
strings.d1.b1.name: Designmuseum Danmark
strings.d1.b1.tips: A corridor of Danish design chairs; an alternative to Rundetårn.
strings.d2.s0.name: Rosenborg Castle
strings.d2.s0.tips: Renaissance castle; the crown jewels are in the basement, and the King's Garden is next door.
strings.d2.s1.name: Kongens Have
strings.d2.s1.tips: The King's Garden; picnics and puppet theatre in summer.
strings.d2.s2.name: Statens Museum for Kunst
strings.d2.s2.tips: National gallery; Matisse and the Danish Golden Age.
strings.d2.s3.name: Aamanns 1921
strings.d2.s4.name: Tivoli Gardens
strings.d2.s4.tips: Amusement park and garden from 1843 that inspired Disney. Lights come on in the evening, with free Friday summer concerts. Entry is 175 plus a ride ticket; Christmas and Halloween seasons in winter.
strings.d2.b0.name: Tivoli Food Hall
strings.d2.b0.tips: Food hall next to the park; no entry ticket needed.
strings.d2.b1.name: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek
strings.d2.b1.tips: Rodin, Gauguin and a winter garden; an alternative to SMK, free on Tuesdays.
strings.d3.s0.name: Church of Our Saviour
strings.d3.s0.tips: Tower with an external spiral staircase, 400 steps; views over the Christianshavn canals.
strings.d3.s1.name: Freetown Christiania
strings.d3.s1.tips: Hippie autonomous district founded in 1971; Pusher Street was closed (2024). Photo rules apply; cafés, Grå Hal.
strings.d3.s2.name: Reffen Street Food
strings.d3.s2.tips: Container street food market on Refshaleøen (April to October); take the harbour bus.
strings.d3.s3.name: Copenhagen Opera House
strings.d3.s3.tips: Henning Larsen's opera house on Holmen; view from outside.
strings.d3.s4.name: Copenhill Amager Bakke
strings.d3.s4.tips: Ski slope and hiking trail on the roof of a waste-to-energy plant; the city views are free.
strings.d3.b0.name: Christianshavns Bådudlejning
strings.d3.b0.tips: Café on the canal; boats for hire.
strings.d3.b1.name: Danish Architecture Center BLOX
strings.d3.b1.tips: Architecture centre with a slide; an alternative to Copenhill.
strings.d4.s0.name: Louisiana Museum of Modern Art
strings.d4.s0.tips: 35 minutes by train (Humlebæk); Giacometti, Kusama and a sculpture garden overlooking the Øresund, one of the world's most beautiful museums.
strings.d4.s1.name: Louisiana Café
strings.d4.s1.tips: Museum café with sea views; smørrebrød buffet.
strings.d4.s2.name: Kronborg Castle
strings.d4.s2.tips: Helsingør: Hamlet's Elsinore, with Holger Danske in the casemates and the Swedish coast across the water.
strings.d4.s3.name: Helsingør Old Town
strings.d4.s3.tips: Medieval streets and the Maritime Museum (BIG); take the train back.
strings.d4.b0.name: Brasserie Kronborg
strings.d4.b0.tips: On Helsingør harbour, next to the castle.
strings.d4.b1.name: Karen Blixen Museum Rungstedlund
strings.d4.b1.tips: Home of the author of Out of Africa; on the way to Louisiana, an alternative to Kronborg.
strings.d5.s0.name: Carlsberg Byen
strings.d5.s0.tips: Former brewery district; the Elephant Gate and Home of Carlsberg (visitor centre 130 DKK).
strings.d5.s1.name: Frederiksberg Gardens
strings.d5.s1.tips: Romantic park and palace; canal boats, and you can see the zoo's elephants.
strings.d5.s2.name: Værnedamsvej
strings.d5.s2.tips: The 'Little Paris' street; granola brunch, cheesemonger and wine shop.
strings.d5.s3.name: Kødbyen Meatpacking
strings.d5.s3.tips: The White Meatpacking District; galleries and evening bars.
strings.d5.s4.name: Warpigs Kødbyen
strings.d5.s4.tips: Mikkeller x Three Floyds beer and Texas BBQ.
strings.d5.b0.name: Hija de Sanchez Kødbyen
strings.d5.b1.name: Copenhagen Zoo
strings.d5.b1.tips: Zoo in Frederiksberg; elephant house by Norman Foster.
strings.d6.s0.name: Assistens Kirkegård
strings.d6.s0.tips: Cemetery-park where Andersen and Kierkegaard are buried; the yellow wall of Nørrebro.
strings.d6.s1.name: Superkilen Park
strings.d6.s1.tips: BIG's red and black multicultural park; Moroccan fountain, Thai boxing ring.
strings.d6.s2.name: Jægersborggade
strings.d6.s2.tips: Nørrebro's hip street; Grød, Meyers Bageri, Coffee Collective.
strings.d6.s3.name: Viking Ship Museum Roskilde
strings.d6.s3.tips: 25 minutes by train; five original Viking ships and the fjord. In summer you can go aboard a ship (May to September).
strings.d6.s4.name: Roskilde Cathedral
strings.d6.s4.tips: Burial place of 40 Danish monarchs; UNESCO-listed brick Gothic.
strings.d6.b0.name: Mirabelle Bakery Nørrebro
strings.d6.b1.name: Frederiksborg Castle Hillerød
strings.d6.b1.tips: Renaissance castle on a lake, home to the Museum of National History; an alternative to Roskilde.
strings.d7.theme: Little Mermaid and a gentle farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Kastellet
strings.d7.s0.tips: Star-shaped fortress and windmill; morning joggers.
strings.d7.s1.name: The Little Mermaid
strings.d7.s1.tips: Statue from 1913 at Langelinie; small and crowded, but a must.
strings.d7.s2.name: Gefion Fountain & St Alban's
strings.d7.s2.tips: The fountain with oxen and the English church.
strings.d7.s3.name: Juno the Bakery Østerbro
strings.d7.s3.tips: The city's best bakery; kardemommebolle (cardamom bun) and a farewell coffee.
strings.d7.s4.name: Østerport Metro Airport
strings.d7.s4.tips: Metro or train to Kastrup in 15 minutes; farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Andersen Bakery Østerbro
strings.d7.b1.name: Nyboder
strings.d7.b1.tips: Yellow sailors' houses; an alternative to the fountain.
strings.note0: The Copenhagen Card (72 hours, 889 DKK) covers transport and museums, including Louisiana, Kronborg and Roskilde; it pays for itself on this plan. Bikes cost 100-150 per day and the city is flat. The airport is 15 minutes by metro.
strings.note1: Summer temperatures are 20-24°C and daylight lasts until 22:00. Try harbour swimming (Islands Brygge), Reffen, Tivoli Friday concerts and Roskilde Festival (late June to July).
strings.note2: Coffee is 45 DKK, smørrebrød 90-150, a restaurant meal 250-400, a beer 60; no tipping. Cards are accepted everywhere (no cash needed).
strings.note3: New Nordic cuisine: Noma has closed, but Geranium and Alchemist remain. Affordable options: Hija de Sanchez, Gasoline Grill burgers, Juno and Hart bakeries.
strings.note4: Photo rules apply in Christiania (none on green light); Pusher Street is closed. Don't walk in the bike lane (cyclists will ring their bells).
strings.note5: Kronborg and Louisiana are covered by the Copenhagen Card; Tivoli's lights come on after 17:00.
strings.transit.name: Copenhagen Card
strings.transit.why_chosen: More than 80 museums plus all public transport (including Louisiana, Kronborg and Roskilde); 889 DKK for 3 days
